## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 14.03.2026 - 10.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Treus626_, 10.10.2026, 1/5: "I am frustrated because I just signed up on this app a few days ago. So far I have only signed up for two classes. The first class I went to, the studio wasn’t even open. I had waited a while, but it was not opened even past the class time. The second one I signed up for was an 8 AM barre class at a gym. I arrive just to find out that the class actually doesn’t start sometime until after 9 AM. I was speaking with a staff member at the gym who told me that he has spoken with few people who were using Class Pass who have experienced the same issue before."
            2. _Lucía Loreto_, 06.10.2026, 1/5: "I had to contact them 3 times to freeze my account and yet they failed. I’m injured and can’t use the credits. They keep me on hold and don’t end up doing their job"
            3. _mattallsop_, 17.08.2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
